mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a field related to a whole range of biotechnologies."
Animal breeding is a field related to a whole range of biotechnologies.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the use of DNA profiling (known as genetic fingerprinting) to determine whether two individuals are biologically parent and child."
DNA paternity testing is the use of DNA profiling (known as genetic fingerprinting) to determine whether two individuals are biologically parent and child.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a technique that simultaneously detects lots of minisatellites in the genome to produce a pattern unique to an individual."
DNA fingerprinting is a technique that simultaneously detects lots of minisatellites in the genome to produce a pattern unique to an individual.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to analyze hunks of biological data more accurately and efficiently by means of automated processes."
Various computational techniques are used to analyze hunks of biological data more accurately and efficiently by means of automated processes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of determining the exact sequence of nucleotides within a DNA molecule."
DNA sequencing is the process of determining the exact sequence of nucleotides within a DNA molecule.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an interdisciplinary field that develops methods and software tools for understanding biological data."
Bioinformatics is an interdisciplinary field that develops methods and software tools for understanding biological data.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the artificial manipulation, modification, and recombination of DNA or other nucleic acid molecules in order to modify an organism or population of organisms."
Genetic engineering is the artificial manipulation, modification, and recombination of DNA or other nucleic acid molecules in order to modify an organism or population of organisms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the extension of interval mapping to multiple QTLs, just as multiple regression extends analysis of variance."
Multiple Interval Mapping (MIM) is the extension of interval mapping to multiple QTLs, just as multiple regression extends analysis of variance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called a DNA vector (carrier)."
The small replicating molecule is called a DNA vector (carrier).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the process of making multiple molecules."
Molecular cloning refers to the process of making multiple molecules.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the co- segregation of marker locus and QTL together."
The basic Principle is the co- segregation of marker locus and QTL together.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the largest single cost item for livestock and poultry production, accounting for 60%-70% of the total cost in most years."
Feed is the largest single cost item for livestock and poultry production, accounting for 60%-70% of the total cost in most years.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the use of DNA sequences to define biological populations by use of molecular tools."
Traditionally genotyping is the use of DNA sequences to define biological populations by use of molecular tools.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of introducing an exogenous gene - called a transgene - into a living organism so that the organism will exhibit a new property and transmit that property to its offspring."

Transgenesis is the process of introducing an exogenous gene - called a transgene - into a living organism so that the organism will exhibit a new property and transmit that property to its offspring.
